elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: HDI must maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence throughout the Agreement term.

elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: HDI must maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: HDI must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: If HDI processes data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for the Company, it must maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 5,000,000.

elements.element: Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
elements.evidence: HDI must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law throughout the Agreement term.

elements.element: Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: HDI must provide certificates of insurance to the Company on request.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The required USD 2,000,000 of professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance exceeds the USD 1,000,000 fallback threshold.

elements.element: Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The cyber and privacy obligation is conditional on HDI processing specified Company-related data; the unconditional fallback element is therefore not met, and the rendered language does not establish that the condition necessarily occurs.
